old_row.relationship: The Lord seated upon the cherubim
old_row.rationale: Psalm 98 describes the reigning Lord seated upon the cherubim. Samuel uses the same throne description when the Lord's ark is carried from Shiloh. The shared divine title does not identify the psalm with that battle or endorse the Israelites' expectation that bringing the ark guarantees victory.

new_row.relationship: The Lord seated upon the cherubim
new_row.rationale: Psalm 98 describes the reigning Lord seated upon the cherubim. The account in 1 Samuel uses the same throne description when the Lord's ark is carried from Shiloh. The shared divine title does not identify the psalm with that battle or endorse the Israelites' expectation that bringing the ark guarantees victory.

changes.reason: Bare Samuel uses can attribute the narrative to the person Samuel. Explicitly name the account in 1 Samuel. The divine cherubim-throne comparison itself is supported.
